Recover movers within a zone defined by start and end position 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0, Removed Pth axes reference, added checks to prevent multiple AOIs recovering the same mover.
============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Instruction to recover movers within a zone defined by start and end position. The recovery behaviour will depend on Cfg_SyncType (0 - ignore recovery, 1 - recover movers using MAM motion command). The mover IDs selected to recover will depend on Cfg_SyncStyle ( 0 - Physical axes (based on axes command position) within the zone limits, 1 - Recovery position within the zone limits,).
Cfg_SyncType = 0 - Ignore recovery Cfg_SyncType = 1, Cfg_SyncStyle = 0. Movers whose command position falls within the zone will be recovered by this instance. Movers will move back to Mover[xx].RecoveryPosition Cfg_SyncType = 1, Cfg_SyncStyle = 1. Movers whose recovery position falls within the zone will be recovered by this instance. Movers will move back to Mover[xx].RecoveryPosition
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1002 Device Handler is faulted. Clear faults to apply commands 1003 Device Handler is not in a Available state 1005 Device Handler is not energized 1007 Recovery is not enabled 1008 Zone start value is invalid. Valid values : 0 <= Zone start <= Track length (in mm) 1009 Zone end value is invalid. Valid values : 0 <= Zone end <= Track length (in mm) 1010 Invalid Cfg_SyncType, valid values: 0 or 1 1011 Invalid Cfg_SyncStyle, valid values: 0 or 1 1012 Velocity cannot be less than or equal to 0mm/s. 1013 Acc/Dec cannot be less than or equal to 0mm/s^2. 1014 Jerk cannot be less than 0 % of time or 100 % of time. 1015 Travel Limit Pos cannot be <=0 or exceed axis unwind. 1016 Travel Limit Neg cannot be >=0 or less than negative axis unwind. 1017 Another recovery zone instance is recovering this mover. Check Sts_EXERR for the first mover to trigger the error. 1018 Distance between the recovery position and command position of the axis is outside Cfg_TravelLimPos or Cfg_TravelLimNeg Limits. Check Sts_EXERR for the first mover to trigger this error code 1019 Mover Sts_EXERR is not energized
Sts_EXERR Enumeration: Sts_EXERR is the first mover to trigger error code 1017, 1018 or 1019.
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0, Removed Pth axes reference, added checks to prevent multiple AOIs recovering the same mover. 4,0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. 1.0 - Release
